facts.fact: Sudan Tribune reports the Ministry of Communications and Digital Transformation announced the previous week that it had begun linking SudaPass to the banking sector so banks can verify customers' identity and update data remotely.

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications

note: The Central Bank's denial (SudaPass registration establishes identity only and does not exempt customers from data updates) is not a fact on the aspects. Date is approximate: 'last week' relative to the 23 Aug 2026 publication.
